create_DOTChannelInfo: create a DOTChannelInfo object with detector and source indices, distances, and spatial coordinates
create_Metric2ChannelInfo: create a Metric2ChannelInfo object with detector source indices and is_Metric1 boolean labels
create_StringChannelInfo: create a StringChannelInfo object from a list of column names for a time series
